steps.summary: Signed into Grafana with username/password 'admin' (skipped the password change prompt), searched for and opened the 'Service health' dashboard, and identified all 3 panel titles: "Request rate", "Error count", and "Latency by endpoint". These were confirmed by h2 headings, region aria-labels, and panel menu titles in the DOM.
Replayed stored procedure s_e595d4; observed panel_title=fwgr7-n2 Availability, url=http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/afwk79qhv4a9sf/fwgr7-n2-bench-dashboard, dashboard_title=fwgr7-n2 Bench Dashboard.

The Text panel (editPanel=2) did not exist yet, so I created it: opened the dashboard's edit mode, added a new visualization, changed it to a Text panel, set its content to 'Notes for run fwgr7-n2' and its title to 'fwgr7-n2 Notes', then closed the editor and clicked Save dashboard. The save succeeded — the 'Dashboard saved' confirmation appeared. The dashboard now shows two panels: 'fwgr7-n2 Notes' (Text, content 'Notes for run fwgr7-n2') and 'fwgr7-n2 Availability' (Stat).

Opened dashboard settings, added the tag 'bench' to the Tags field (verified the tag 'bench' is present in settings). Set the dashboard's time range to 'Last 6 hours' (confirmed in the top bar time picker). Saved the dashboard and received the 'Dashboard saved' confirmation. The dashboard's two panels are 'fwgr7-n2 Notes' (Text panel with content 'Notes for run fwgr7-n2') and 'fwgr7-n2 Availability' (Stat panel).

Set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to '1m' via the time range picker popover. Saved the dashboard with 'Update default time range' checked and received the 'Dashboard saved' confirmation. After saving, the auto-refresh interval shown in the top bar is '1m'.

Fresh page load confirmed: (1) Dashboard title: "fwgr7-n2 Bench Dashboard" in breadcrumbs. (2) Panel titles: "fwgr7-n2 Notes" (Text) and "fwgr7-n2 Availability" (Stat). (3) Time range: "Last 6 hours" in the time picker. (4) Auto-refresh interval: "1m" shown in the top bar. (5) Tags in settings: ["bench"]. (6) Panel "fwgr7-n2 Availability" uses data source "TestData" (grafana-testdata-datasource, uid: benchtestdata) with visualization type "Stat". (7) Notes panel content: "Notes for run fwgr7-n2".
